met_source: Existing exact LamaH-CE v1.0 A_basins_total_upstrm ERA5-Land; prec daily mm sum, 2m_temp_mean degC daily mean; full unique calendar days required; previous true calendar month P, including2017-12
Q_primary: Official provider daily data or official provider-curated dataset; full unique daily rows each calendar month, finite nonnegative observations, no documented suspect flags. Do not pretend provider-no-flags equals ckhs1. Provider-curated series with absent per-day QC allowed only as explicitly qualified descriptive P6 evidence, never hydrological certification.
Q_secondary: EStreams monthly mean may document availability but cannot enter primary P6 unless full-day support and monthly aggregation/units are traceable; missing day counts not invented.
identity: Exact official provider gauge code + river + official area + coordinate check. German coordinates tolerance100m; Swiss rounded EStreams coordinates require primary CAMELS/FOEN identity confirmation, <=1km cross-CRS metadata tolerance with source rounding/migration caveat. Conflicting names require independent primary identity evidence.
quality_selection: No score-based basin/month rejection. Freeze date/quality supported sample IDs before model predictions. Any finite/negative contradiction discovered after seal aborts primary scoring, no silent reselection.
prediction_commit: All eligible 2-model predictions including raw/nonnegative and frozen80/90 intervals saved and SHA256 sealed before evaluator loads 2018-19 numeric Q. Q intake role may reduce numerical tokens to finite/nonnegative support flags; never passes Q to prediction process.
uncertainty: Intervals unchanged, no recalibration; negative lower bound preserved. Interval Score=(U-L)+2/a*(L-y)I(y<L)+2/a*(y-U)I(y>U).
minimum_support: At least12 eligible months per station for overall descriptive metrics; all supported months reported; n<12 row N/A reason insufficient. With <=3 basins/2years no universal confirmation, no station-independence assumption.
historical_diagnostics: All P4-V1 residual analyses descriptive only; V2 train-period application not independent validation.
prohibited: No teacher Q, no new model fit, no alpha/window/grid changes, no EOBS replacement, no website-production permission change
